description: All four body-confirmed February candidates lack a person turnout count or clear qualitative evidence sufficient to establish at least 50 participants. Vehicle totals, workforce totals, and occupational group sizes are not attendee counts.
required_followup: Locate independent contemporaneous accounts or primary records with human attendance and clarify local versus multi-site counts.

description: The CUT account of 20 February summarizes actions across five regions without establishing a common event boundary; the Juntos! account describes varied local student activities on 25 February, with no common local coordination or attendance data.
required_followup: Coordinator review of national versus local event coding; do not split or merge by city from the present evidence.

description: No body-reviewed source establishes a physical end for any of the four February candidates. CUT’s planned 21 February schedule is not evidence that events occurred, continued, or ended on that date.
required_followup: Search event-specific contemporaneous reporting for physical closure; retain null end dates until supported.

description: Read reports do not establish protester violence or event-specific accommodation, arrests, beatings, crowd dispersal, ignoring, killings, or shootings for the February candidates. Silence is coded unknown.
required_followup: Seek event-specific accounts; do not transfer general campaign, city, or background policing claims.

description: Several relevant exact-URL body requests stopped without article content: S018 returned HTTP 402, S022 HTTP 403, and S038 HTTP 401. These are recorded as blocked and were not retried or bypassed. Other attempts had cache-miss/DNS technical failures, which are not treated as denials.
required_followup: Use only a newly checked permitted source or independent source; do not retry URLs with actual denial evidence.

description: February 1 truck-driver strike/protests, including reported road gatherings in the Northeast, remain unverified from body evidence; search-result headlines are discovery only.
required_followup: Seek an accessible contemporary account of actual public gatherings, state-directed demands and human attendance; distinguish workers who stopped work from protest participants.

description: The exact date and execution of reports about Indigenous actions at the Funai headquarters remain unverified. S038’s exact URL returned HTTP 401; S039–S041 have no body-read evidence.
required_followup: Use an independently accessible contemporary source; do not transfer date, attendance, or response details from titles/snippets.

description: Additional teacher, public-service and health-worker strike/protest leads from search remain unverified as public gatherings meeting unit criteria.
required_followup: Verify actual execution, date, public gathering, government/policy target, and human attendance before creating candidates.

description: An opened February 1 publication reports car/bicycle actions that occurred 31 January, and no opened February body proves those same actions continued into this month. The 20 February CUT report is a later, separately dated mobilization with its own organizers and demands.
required_followup: Compare episode identity only if new source evidence connects the February 20 campaign to the January 31 episode; do not infer continuity from similar demands.

description: Searches covered 31 captured queries (867 returned headers), English and Portuguese terms, weekly/month-boundary windows, nationwide/local sectors and retrospective reporting. This bounded open-web pass does not establish absence or completeness; snippets are discovery only and the original Mass Mobilization codebook/baseline were not available in the worker unit. LexisNexis/news archives and full source-corpus coverage were not verified.
required_followup: Coordinator review against the official baseline and codebook; additional archival search is needed for completeness and unresolved leads.
